# This vs. That

> A comprehensive comparison directory covering visas, aircraft, compounds, entities, and language concepts with detailed guides on semantic and grammatical differences.

This vs. That provides side-by-side comparisons across multiple domains including travel documentation (visa types), military aircraft (fighters and bombers), chemical compounds, business entities, and English language usage. The site serves as both a browsable directory and a detailed reference for understanding distinctions between commonly confused terms and categories.

## Key Topics

- Visa types (A-1, Student, F-16)
- Military aircraft (A-10, F-35, B-2 Bomber, Su-25, Tu-160)
- Language comparisons
- Semantic differences
- Grammar guides
- English phrases
- File formats
- Search engines
- Definitions
- Word comparisons
- Comparison directory
- Chemical compounds
- Business entities
- Alphabetical index
- Browse all

## Comparison Directory

- [Explore](https://thisvsthat.io/explore): Browse directory of all comparisons: visas, aircraft, compounds, entities

## Language & Grammar Guides

- [Real vs. True](https://thisvsthat.io/real-vs-true): Language guide comparing semantic differences between Real and True
- [Start Doing vs. Start to Do](https://thisvsthat.io/start-doing-vs-start-to-do): Grammar guide on English phrase usage differences and formality levels

## Technology & File Formats

- [PPT vs. PPTX](https://thisvsthat.io/ppt-vs-pptx): File format comparison: PowerPoint PPT vs PPTX compatibility and features

## Search Engines & Services

- [Google vs. Yandex](https://thisvsthat.io/google-vs-yandex): Search engine comparison: Google vs Yandex algorithms and regional differences
